detailed_descriptions.en: Fireside Feelings is a mental wellness experience that promotes empathy, connection, and positivity among players. So grab a blanket, your favourite hoody, and a nice beverage and come chat around the campfire. “Do your childhood dreams still echo in who you’ve become?” “Do you prefer to cook food, or have someone cook food for you?” Share your thoughts on a range of topics - sometimes sweet, sometimes profound - to help create a rich and meaningful tapestry of thoughts and feelings that are personal and authentic. Unlock objects to furnish your campfire, and make it your place to stop and take a breath. Share experiences, express your emotions, and be a part of a caring community. Conversations are with real people, but are not live, and there is no direct interaction with others. Discover their thoughts at your own pace. Answers are moderated and filtered to ensure your safety. Content warnings can be set according to your preferences so certain topics are avoided.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Fireside Feelings is a mental wellness experience that promotes empathy, connection, and positivity among players. So grab a blanket, your favourite hoody, and a nice beverage and come chat around the campfire.

“Do your childhood dreams still echo in who you’ve become?”

“Do you prefer to cook food, or have someone cook food for you?”

Share your thoughts on a range of topics - sometimes sweet, sometimes profound - to help create a rich and meaningful tapestry of thoughts and feelings that are personal and authentic.

Unlock objects to furnish your campfire, and make it your place to stop and take a breath.

Share experiences, express your emotions, and be a part of a caring community.

Conversations are with real people, but are not live, and there is no direct interaction with others. Discover their thoughts at your own pace.

Answers are moderated and filtered to ensure your safety. Content warnings can be set according to your preferences so certain topics are avoided.
